dedupe_keys.name: a hetero functional graph of the future american electric power system xml

description: A Hetero-functional Graph of the Future American Electric Power System XML is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Amro Farid, Dartmouth College (dartmouth.edu). This project can be used to recreate the test case, Hetero-functional graph theory (HFGT) compliant, XML input file that was used in the IEEE Access journal paper “A Hetero- functional Graph Resilience Analysis of the Future American Electric Powe System”. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Hetero-functional Graph Theory, Graph Theory, Electric Grid. Published 2021-10-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
